**daemon, recall:** new `meaning` op answers a natural-language question from code-chunk embeddings kept resident in the daemon, ranking exactly as `pixel search-meaning` does in about 3 ms once warm (requests in a burst) instead of 250 ms. It answers `unavailable` with a reason (cold, warming, stale, model missing) instead of waiting, builds in the background, never downloads the model and never indexes credential-shaped paths. `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 16.
